entry.title: New: Resolution 378 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HĀMĀKUA HEALTH CENTER, INC., TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR ITS PANIOLA IN PALAKA BREAST CANCER AWARENESS COMMUNITY EVENT

Transfers $1,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)

Latest action: Council: Adopted Res. 378-25 - 11/5/2025
